unlisted_practices: Training medical diagnostic agents in an interactive multi-agent simulated clinical environment with trajectory-level rule-based rewards
Self-evolution methods to improve agent diagnostic capability

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a simulated multi-agent environment (ClinVerse) for training and evaluating medical diagnostic agents on electronic health record cases. It evaluates agent architectures and self-evolution methods rather than testing health care deployment guardrails or implementation practices.
